notes.title: Game Update v5.1.0
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Tank Battle: North Africa - update v4.1.5
notes.content:
Change: Play balance in the 'Aces Hight' mission.
Change: Play balance in the 'Longstop Hill' mission.
Update: Some German transport vehicles to Sd.Kfz 7's.

notes.title: Tank Battle: North Africa - update version 4.1.4
notes.content:
Change: Play balance in the 'Longstop Hill' mission.
Fix: The end turn button highlight is the wrong size on some devices.

notes.title: Tank Battle: North Africa version 4.1.3 update
notes.content:
Add: some additional UK weapon crew animations.
Change: Some improvements to the main map display.

notes.title: Tank Battle: North Africa v4.1.2 update
notes.content: Change: The terrain image for rocks.  The previous update was not a satisfactory image.

notes.title: Tank Battle: North Africa v4.1.0
notes.content:
Change: Play balance in the 'Longstop Hill' mission.
Change: Play balance in the 'Aces High' mission.
Change: The tree density on some maps.
Fix: Some terrain was not providing cover against shooting, as per the terrain effects chart.
Fix: Some woodland hexes were incorrectly allowing units to pass through them in a single movement action.
Update: Some game text.

notes.title: Tank Battle: North Africa - version 4.0.6 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Change: Airstrip Assult Mission - Slightly harder, added objective labels.

[*] Change: Play balance in the 'Airport Security' mission.

[*] Change: Play balance in the 'Hafid Ridge' mission.
[*] Change: Play balance in the 'Tobruk' mission.
[*] Change: Play balance in the 'Land Grab' mission.
[*] Change: Play balance in the 'Retaliation' mission.
[*] Change: The Bonus 'Strike Out!' Campaign is now available to all players without requiring an email registration.
[/list]

[*] Add: Control point labels in the 'Secure the Area' mission.
[*] Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Tank Battle: North Africa version 4.0.2 release notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Add: Some new weapon animations.
[*] Add: Support for the Metal graphics system.
[*] Change: Improved: computer player A.I.
[*] Update: Play balance in the 'Forest Fire' mission, following some A.I. changes.
[*] Update: Play balance in the 'Hammer Down' mission,
[*] Update: Play balance in the 'Panzer Races' mission.

[*] Update: Play balance in the 'Secure the Area' mission.
[*] Update: Play balance in the 'Taking Control' mission.
[*] Change: Reduction in the download size.
[*] Change: Updated some button images.
[*] Change: Update the About Game window.
[*] Fix: Missing some mount/dismount buttons.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
[*] Fix: The in-game player message were sometimes cropped at the left edge of the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: v2.9
notes.content:
We've just released the first patch for Tank Battle: North Africa!

Changes included in this patch:

[list]
[*]Add: A whole new way to play, 'Historical Mode'.  This is now an option on starting a new mission.
[*]Add: 'Historical Mode' preference to the settings menu.
[*]Add: Change log for all updates in the latest edition of the game.
[*]Add: Change log to the help menu.
[/list]

Thanks for supporting our games and please keep the feedback coming! 

~ The HexWar Games Team

notes.title: Command & Colors: The Great War released!
notes.content:
HexWar Games has partnered with Plastic Soldier Company to bring you a digital version of Command & Colors: The Great War board game. The game allow players to portray important engagements throughout WWI history. The battles focus on the historical deployment of forces and important terrain features of trench fighting in scale with the game system.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/449460/

notes.title: First Patch Released!
notes.content:
We've just released the first patch for Tank Battle: North Africa!

Changes included in this patch:
[list]
[*] Add option to disable map zoom / fixed camera.
[*] Expanded settings including option to always use HD graphics.
[*] Ability to restart scenario from in game.
[*] Keyboard shortcuts.
[/list]
Thanks for supporting our games and please keep the feedback coming! 

~ The HexWar Games Team
